$comment: Community skills Aizen USES BUT DOES NOT COPY: they stay installed from upstream and follow its updates. `node bin/cli.js external install <name>` fetches one; `node bin/cli.js external update <name>` shows the new upstream commits, then fast-forwards. Nothing here runs on npm install, sync or auto-update. Aizen packs list them under `optional` in manifest.json and fall back when they are missing.

externals.name: archify
externals.needs: Node.js >= 18; Chrome or Chromium for its browser-check gate
externals.why: Interactive, validated architecture / workflow / sequence / dataflow / lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML. Used as an optional companion to the ASCII diagrams in Aizen design docs (references/design/diagrams.md).
